pass: Pass 20 — Timers / Resets / World Rules Closure
policy: Promote only retained MajorMUD 1.11p/native evidence or strong cross-source correlations. Do not infer universal timer semantics from one subsystem. Unresolved reset ordering, zero-delay behavior, restart/missed-timer behavior, buffer ownership, and host-clock phase remain UNKNOWN.

direct_findings.runtime_binding: RuntimeClassicTimingAuthority.BufferDataSaveIntervalSeconds = 300 is retained as evidence only until exact native buffer participants and ordering are recovered

native_wccmmud_configuration.boundary: The two interval values do not prove cross-participant save ordering, dirty-buffer semantics, shutdown/crash behavior, rollback, or which Reforged world-state stores correspond to native Buffer data.

findings.behavior: Exit waits five seconds and the character is saved when exit completes. This was already scored before Pass 20; the timing constant is centralized in RuntimeClassicTimingAuthority.
REST and MEDITATE require at least 20 seconds before the increased regeneration takes effect; moving, attacking, or being attacked during that period terminates the state and yields no bonus.

native_help_timing.runtime_correction: Ordinary non-movement commands no longer cancel focused regeneration. Movement cancels at command dispatch and actual PvE/PvP combat-entry paths cancel the attacker/defender states.

strings: Room Max: %d  Current: %d  Last Killed: %s Delay: %d
native_binary_correlation.finding: The native binary exposes Last Killed, Delay, room population, and a minutes-before-regenerating diagnostic family.

room_entry_evidence.finding: Resetting monster Last Killed makes monsters regenerate the next time someone walks into the room.

runtime_binding: RuntimeLivingWorldService.Tick no longer materializes due NPC respawns from the global heartbeat
RuntimeLivingWorldService.AdmitDueNpcRespawnsForRoom admits only due slots whose home room matches the entered room
RuntimeCommandDispatcher calls room-entry admission after successful player movement and after successful party-follower movement before room rendering
remaining_unknown: simultaneous multiple due-spawn ordering beyond deterministic Reforged ordering

world_reset_boundary.finding: Pass 20 does not promote the existing room/area reset policy shell to native MajorMUD truth. Exact reset categories, hard-reset encodings, active-player/combat behavior, corpse/limited-item survival, owner ordering, rollback, and restart interaction still require native evidence.
